description: Excel accent comparisons of mark runs whose wrapped weight is small (T-3201): Calc!<col j+1><row i> = (x<y)+2*(x=y)+4*(x>y) for x = Data!A<i>, y = Data!A<j> over 37 strings: references a, á, à, a+U+0307, â, ä, å, a+1-3 U+030D, a+U+0341, a+U+0340 (A1:A12), then runs of U+0301, U+030A, U+0323, U+0342, U+0300, U+0302 and U+030D grouped by wrapped sum mod 256 (2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 14, 18, 22; A13:A37), to tell whether equal sums compare equal.
